statement:
∀ (E : Type) [inst : TopologicalSpace E] (K : Set E),
  IsCompact K →
    K.Nonempty →
      ∀ (f : E → ℝ),
        ContinuousOn f K → BddAbove (f '' K) ∧ BddBelow (f '' K) ∧ (∃ a ∈ K, IsMaxOn f K a) ∧ ∃ b ∈ K, IsMinOn f K b

# name: set-extreme-values-test
# technique: test fallback (test_fallback recipe): instances the kernel checks, chosen by hand
# goal: sage_test KaluzaKlein.Sets.Compact.extreme_values
# description: the claim at the instances below, each proved independently of the claim
SEED = 0
CASES = [
    (['ℝ', 'inferInstance', 'Set.Icc 0 2', 'isCompact_Icc', '⟨0, by norm_num⟩', 'fun x => x * Real.exp (-x)', '(by fun_prop : Continuous fun x : ℝ => x * Real.exp (-x)).continuousOn'], False, "have key : ∀ (E : Type) [inst1 : TopologicalSpace E] (K : Set E) (hK : IsCompact K) (hne : K.Nonempty) (f : E → ℝ) (hf : ContinuousOn f K), BddAbove (f '' K) ∧ BddBelow (f '' K) ∧ (∃ a ∈ K, IsMaxOn f K a) ∧ ∃ b ∈ K, IsMinOn f K b := by
  intro E inst1 K hK hne f hf
  exact (⟨(hK.image_of_continuousOn hf).bddAbove, (hK.image_of_continuousOn hf).bddBelow, hK.exists_isMaxOn hne hf,
    hK.exists_isMinOn hne hf⟩)
exact @key (ℝ) (inferInstance) (Set.Icc 0 2) (isCompact_Icc) (⟨0, by norm_num⟩) (fun x => x * Real.exp (-x)) ((by fun_prop : Continuous fun x : ℝ => x * Real.exp (-x)).continuousOn)"),
    (['ℝ', 'inferInstance', '{0}', 'isCompact_singleton', '⟨0, rfl⟩', 'id', 'continuousOn_id'], True, "have key : ∀ (E : Type) [inst1 : TopologicalSpace E] (K : Set E) (hK : IsCompact K) (hne : K.Nonempty) (f : E → ℝ) (hf : ContinuousOn f K), BddAbove (f '' K) ∧ BddBelow (f '' K) ∧ (∃ a ∈ K, IsMaxOn f K a) ∧ ∃ b ∈ K, IsMinOn f K b := by
  intro E inst1 K hK hne f hf
  exact (⟨(hK.image_of_continuousOn hf).bddAbove, (hK.image_of_continuousOn hf).bddBelow, hK.exists_isMaxOn hne hf,
    hK.exists_isMinOn hne hf⟩)
exact @key (ℝ) (inferInstance) ({0}) (isCompact_singleton) (⟨0, rfl⟩) (id) (continuousOn_id)"),
    (['ℝ', 'inferInstance', 'Set.Icc (-1) 1', 'isCompact_Icc', '⟨0, by norm_num⟩', 'Real.cos', 'Real.continuous_cos.continuousOn'], False, "have key : ∀ (E : Type) [inst1 : TopologicalSpace E] (K : Set E) (hK : IsCompact K) (hne : K.Nonempty) (f : E → ℝ) (hf : ContinuousOn f K), BddAbove (f '' K) ∧ BddBelow (f '' K) ∧ (∃ a ∈ K, IsMaxOn f K a) ∧ ∃ b ∈ K, IsMinOn f K b := by
  intro E inst1 K hK hne f hf
  exact (⟨(hK.image_of_continuousOn hf).bddAbove, (hK.image_of_continuousOn hf).bddBelow, hK.exists_isMaxOn hne hf,
    hK.exists_isMinOn hne hf⟩)
exact @key (ℝ) (inferInstance) (Set.Icc (-1) 1) (isCompact_Icc) (⟨0, by norm_num⟩) (Real.cos) (Real.continuous_cos.continuousOn)"),
]
instances = [kernel_instance(*values, proof=proof, edge=edge) for values, edge, proof in CASES]

goal.text: BddAbove (f '' K) ∧ BddBelow (f '' K) ∧ (∃ a ∈ K, IsMaxOn f K a) ∧ ∃ b ∈ K, IsMinOn f K b
